scope: Unarmed firmware startup, identity, complete parameter readback, and reproducible launch preparation only
limits: A smoke PASS does not validate ExternalNav delivery, actual multi-sensor fusion, EKF fusion, flight readiness, or closed-loop flight.
The default quad smoke uses ArduPilot internal dynamics; a JSON/Gazebo launch plan requires its own live Gazebo and full-chain experiments.
VISO_QUAL_MIN=0 allows unknown quality; receipt health remains distinct from measurement validity.
Historical 4.5.7 evidence remains bound to 4.5.7 and is never relabelled as 4.7.1.
